verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centered story stack and hierarchy, but the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon has shrunk and lost its punch. The bottom is also cramped: headline, body copy, CTA and legal line are packed tightly together while there is dead space above the bottle. B breaks the hierarchy. The huge headline overwhelms a tiny 'Claim the Deal' button. Body copy and legal text are squeezed into a narrow right column with awkward multi-line wraps, and the legal text is almost as large as the body copy. The bottle floats at the left with no shared alignment, and the ribbon sits at top right over a bubble, so the layout feels arbitrary.
